name: due_dates
about: Monthly statutory dates for a GST-registered business. `day` is the day of the month after the period (`month_offset` 1) unless noted. `applies` is who it is for. Extensions announced by the government override these - check the portal.

rows.what: TDS / TCS deposit for last month (March: 30 April)
rows.if_missed: Interest 1% a month (not deducted) or 1.5% a month (deducted, not paid); the expense can be disallowed.
rows.source: docs/research/accounts/03_rules_and_calendar.md s3.4 (dates under the Income-tax Rules 2026 not read on primary)

rows.if_missed: Late fee Rs 50 a day (Rs 20 nil), capped by turnover; your buyers do not see their credit.

rows.what: IFF - invoices for months 1-2 of the quarter (QRMP filers, optional)
rows.if_missed: Those B2B invoices wait for the quarterly GSTR-1.

rows.what: GSTR-2B is made; act in IMS (accept / reject / pending) and recompute 2B before GSTR-3B
rows.if_missed: No action = deemed accepted; wrong credit means interest and penalty later.

rows.what: GSTR-3B + tax payment (monthly filers). Its sales figures are LOCKED to GSTR-1 / 1A - fix sales in GSTR-1A before this.
rows.if_missed: 18% interest - now worked out by the portal and it cannot be lowered; late fee capped by turnover; returns more than 3 years old can no longer be filed.

rows.what: PMT-06 tax payment for months 1-2 of the quarter (QRMP filers)
rows.if_missed: Interest on the tax paid late.
